Zoe: Opened PR 5132 to add short Rust+Java parity snippets and a quant-profile example for the Optimize toolkit (batching + kv-prefetch). Quick review please, small fixes expected.

Kai: What needs attention?

Zoe: Two tiny things: the console link points to /opt/kv (should be /console/optimize/kv-prefetch) and the Rust snippet had an extra brace breaking cargo check. Also added a short microbench note (shortseq p95 ~4% improvement). Bench command in PR: 

```bash
# reproduce microbench
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/bench:/bench redwood/opt-bench:stable --model redwood/13b-q --input /bench/shortseq-1k --mode kv-prefetch --batch 8 --iters 150
```

Marta: I fixed the link and removed the extra brace, ran cargo check OK. Pushed commit 2.

DocsBot: PR 5132  automerge blocked: missing i18n frontmatter in docs/en/optimize/kv-prefetch.md (l10n-check).

Zoe: Adding frontmatter now.

Kai: Quick Java compile check passed after import tweak to ai.redwood.optimize. Approving.

Marta: Approved and merged. :tada:

Zoe: Thanks all — will add a short entry to the docs changelog and link the bench command for reproducibility. :rocket:
